The Croft Primary School Announces Part-Time Class Teacher Vacancy for Maternity Cover

The Croft Primary School in Swindon, Wiltshire, has announced a job vacancy for a part-time Class Teacher providing maternity cover. According to the school's listing published through the official teaching vacancies service, the position is offered on a part-time basis for up to 12 months, requiring 19.50 hours per week.

Position Overview and Salary

  • Role: Class Teacher (Part Time, MAT Cover)
  • Hours: 19.50 per week (working days to be discussed at interview)
  • Salary Range: MPS 1 to MPS 6 (£19,749.60 to £27,211.20)
  • Location: Swindon, Wiltshire

Application and Review Process

The school states that applications will be reviewed as they are received. The listing indicates that the vacancy may close early if a suitable candidate is identified prior to any stated deadline, encouraging interested applicants to apply early.

About the School and Trust

The Croft Primary School is part of The White Horse Federation multi-academy trust. The school was rated Outstanding across all areas in its November 2024 Ofsted inspection.

Requirements and Checks

Applicants should note that employment offers are subject to standard background checks in line with safeguarding guidance, which may include obtaining a disclosure from the Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS), reference checks, and verification of the right to work. CVs are not accepted for this application process.

How to Verify

Interested candidates can review the original vacancy announcement and submit applications directly through the official Teaching Vacancies service or by visiting the employer's designated recruitment portal.
